grammar.title: 过去完成时
grammar.explanation: 过去完成时表示在过去某个时间或动作之前已经完成的动作，结构为 had + 过去分词。常与 by the time, before, already 等连用。
examples: She had already left before Ted arrived at the bar.
Marshall had discussed the idea with Lily for weeks before he announced it.

grammar.title: even though 引导的让步状语从句
grammar.explanation: even though 意为“尽管“，引导让步状语从句，表示虽然某个事实存在，但主句的情况仍然发生。
examples: Even though it was raining, they went out for a walk.
Ted smiled even though his love life was complicated.

grammar.title: too...to 结构
grammar.explanation: too + 形容词/副词 + to do sth. 表示“太……以至于不能……“，相当于 so...that... 的否定形式。
examples: Robin was too upset to talk about her feelings.
The box was too heavy to carry alone.

grammar.title: 不定式作宾语补足语
grammar.explanation: 某些动词如 want, ask, tell, help 后面可接宾语 + 不定式（to do）作宾语补足语，表示让某人做某事。
examples: Marshall wanted Lily to start a family with him.
Her friends tried to comfort Robin.

grammar.title: on the other hand 转折表达
grammar.explanation: on the other hand 意为“另一方面“，用于引出与前文相对或不同的观点，常用于对比两种情况。
examples: Robin was miserable, but on the other hand, Marshall was full of enthusiasm.

grammar.title: so...that... 句型

grammar.title: not only...but also... 结构
